title: Pointwise splitting of the contracted exterior derivative: flatD(dω) = Σ_a (−1)^a D_{g_a}(flatF a ∘ ω) + (−1)^{j+1} d(flat ∘ ω)
statement:
Let P, j, m, n' ∈ ℕ, let g = (g_0, …, g_j) (g : Fin (j + 1) → Euclid P) be any family of vectors, and let h : n' = (j + 1) + m, h₁ : n' + 1 = (j + 1) + (m + 1) and h₂ : n' = j + (m + 1). Let flatD : Λ^{n'+1} → Λ^{m+1}, flat : Λ^{n'} → Λ^m and flatF a : Λ^{n'} → Λ^{m+1} (a ∈ Fin (j + 1)) be continuous linear maps with flatD α v = α(Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h₁), flat α v = α(Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h) and flatF a α v = α(Fin.append (g ∘ a.succAbove) v ∘ Fin.cast h₂) for all covectors α and tuples v (Λ^i := Covector (Euclid P) i). Let ω be an n'-form on ℝ^P (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') that is differentiable at x ∈ ℝ^P. Then, in Λ^{m+1},
flatD(dω(x)) = Σ_{a ∈ Fin (j+1)} (−1)^a · D[z ↦ flatF a(ω(z))](x)[g_a] + (−1)^{j+1} · d[z ↦ flat(ω(z))](x),
where D = fderiv ℝ and d = exteriorDerivative.
lean_statement: ∀ (P j m n' : ℕ) (g : Fin (j + 1) → Euclid P) (h : n' = (j + 1) + m) (h₁ : n' + 1 = (j + 1) + (m + 1)) (h₂ : n' = j + (m + 1)) (flatD : Covector (Euclid P) (n' + 1) →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (flat : Covector (Euclid P) n' →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) m) (flatF : Fin (j + 1) → Covector (Euclid P) n' →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (x : Euclid P), DifferentiableAt ℝ ω x → (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) (n' + 1)) (v : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P), flatD α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h₁)) → (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n') (v : Fin m → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h)) → (∀ (a : Fin (j + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n') (v : Fin (m + 1) → Euclid P), flatF a α v = α (Fin.append (g ∘ a.succAbove) v ∘ Fin.cast h₂)) → flatD (exteriorDerivative ω x) = ∑ a : Fin (j + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ (a : ℕ) • fderiv ℝ (fun z => flatF a (ω z)) x (g a) + (-1 : ℝ) ^ (j + 1) • exteriorDerivative (fun z => flat (ω z)) x
